pages.title: PrismRoll 3D
pages.creator: Dharjiya Studios
pages.description: PrismRoll 3D challenges you to roll a block into a red target hole. Cross fragile tiles, activate bridge switches, and use teleporters or split pads without falling off the edges. Work through one hundred levels and customize the block's appearance between puzzles.

pages.title: Springle Puzzle
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Springle Puzzle turns jigsaw assembly into a timed challenge. Choose a piece style such as Classic, Irregular, Hexagon, or Wave, then drag matching sections together. Fewer pieces make a quicker puzzle, while larger arrangements offer a harder route to a higher score.

pages.title: Break Beat
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description: Break Beat is a neon brick breaker where impacts recolor the ball and paddle. Hit bricks matching the paddle's shade to release energy-restoring protons, while missed balls reduce the supply. Clear the board and keep replenishing energy as its drain accelerates.

pages.title: Sophie's Farm
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Sophie's Farm follows a mother rebuilding her life through a farm business. Merge matching items to produce goods requested by customers, then complete their orders for income. Spend the earnings restoring locations as the tasks reveal more of Sophie's story.

pages.title: Ice Cream Inc.
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description: Ice Cream Inc. asks you to recreate frozen desserts using a reference model. Select base flavors, hold the dispenser to form the swirl, and match the example's height and shape. Add toppings to finish the ice cream you have prepared for the shop.

pages.title: Woods of Nevia: Forest Survival
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Woods of Nevia: Forest Survival puts you in a woodland wilderness with an axe and limited supplies. Fight wolves, cut timber, build shelter, and search for resources or hidden chests. Gain levels and choose upgrades while managing hunger and health against growing dangers.

pages.title: Vikings: An Archer's Journey
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Vikings: An Archer's Journey follows Nott on a mission to rescue her wolf from the Underworld. Jump through an endless running course and pull back to aim arrows at threats. Collect upgrades while combining precise shooting with the timing needed to keep moving.

pages.title: Wordling: Daily Word Challenge
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description: Wordling: Daily Word Challenge gives you six attempts to identify a hidden word. Enter a guess and study the colored feedback to learn which letters fit. Use those clues to refine the next answer before the available guesses are used up.

pages.title: Combine Pickaxes
pages.creator: GreeMead
pages.description: Combine Pickaxes lets you buy and merge tools that break rocks, trees, and other objects for money. Combine similar devices into more powerful versions and reinvest the earnings. Stronger tools destroy obstacles faster, helping you expand the collection and continue through the levels.

pages.title: Puzzle About Orange
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Puzzle About Orange challenges you to assemble a complete shape from orange-themed pieces. Drag the parts into positions where their outlines fit together. Beat the countdown to finish each arrangement and continue into puzzles that demand more careful spatial planning.

pages.title: Gem Deep Digger
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Gem Deep Digger sends you underground to carve through dirt and rock. Dig into deeper layers, collect exposed gems, and uncover hidden treasures along the way. Use the available upgrades to improve the mining operation as you continue exploring below the surface.

pages.title: Tile Fruits
pages.creator: Newness Games
pages.description: Tile Fruits asks you to select fruit pictures and complete sets of three identical pieces. Remove the matching trios to clear the arrangement and advance. Each new level changes the layout and adds a more demanding fruit-matching puzzle to solve.

pages.title: Cat Cut
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Cat Cut challenges you to send a fish to a hungry cat through physics puzzles. Cut ropes, swing objects, or give pieces a push according to the arrangement. Plan how the fish will travel so it reaches the cat rather than missing its target.

pages.title: Paperly - Paper Plane Adventure
pages.creator: Felicity Games
pages.description: Paperly - Paper Plane Adventure gives you a paper aircraft to guide through a physics-based journey. Control its movement and use boosts to help reach the destination. Learn from unsuccessful flights and adjust the next attempt as you continue exploring the flight mechanics.

pages.title: Fast Lap
pages.creator: josemiguelguerrero
pages.description: Fast Lap asks you to manage a racing car's speed with one touch. Hold to accelerate on straight sections and release before curves to slow down. Keep the balance between speed and grip, since taking a bend too quickly sends the car spinning out.

pages.title: Tower Defense Dragon Merge
pages.creator: Felicity Games
pages.description: Tower Defense Dragon Merge combines merging defenders with protecting a castle from invaders. Build stronger units, reinforce the walls, and press the cannon button for extra firepower during attacks. Spin for shop power-ups as you improve the army between increasingly demanding battles.

pages.title: Good Yard
pages.creator: Game Worthy Studios Inc.
pages.description: Good Yard lets you grow and sell flowers through a gardening routine. Dig the soil, plant seeds, water the crop, and prune it before selling with the basket. Spend the proceeds on better tools and unlock more valuable flowers for the yard.

pages.title: Noob Chicken Farm Tycoon
pages.creator: OleAle
pages.description: Noob Chicken Farm Tycoon has you collect eggs, improve chickens, and buy farm equipment. Customize the birds with character masks or replace them with unusual producers, including a toilet that makes paper. Expand the operation as you purchase upgrades and gather its output.

pages.title: Agent Fall 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Agent Fall 3D challenges you to lower an agent safely toward the ground. Hold to stop the descent when an obstacle is in the way, then continue through a clear opening. Reach the landing point within the time limit while avoiding the hazards.

pages.title: Carrom Hero
pages.creator: Advergame Technologies Private Limited
pages.description: Carrom Hero offers online matches in Freestyle and Professional modes. Set the striker's angle, drag to choose its force, and send it across the board toward the discs. Use accurate shots to pocket pieces while competing with other players at the carrom table.

pages.title: Tall Man Evolution
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Tall Man Evolution sends a runner through gates that increase height and width. Steer toward useful upgrades and avoid obstacles that damage the growing character. Reach the end large enough to destroy the robots waiting beyond the course and complete the level.

pages.title: Marble Dash
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Marble Dash challenges you to stop a chain of colored marbles before it reaches the path's end. Shoot groups of at least three matching colors to remove them and build combos. Swap the loaded marble or use helpful items when the next clear is difficult.

pages.title: Trial Bike Epic Stunts
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Trial Bike Epic Stunts offers Mission and Skill modes across mountain, factory, and underwater courses. Ride and jump through the route's challenges while working toward the finish. Learn the demands of each mode as you guide the bike safely through its stunt sections.

pages.title: Emoji Guess Puzzle: AI
pages.creator: OneTwoPlay
pages.description: Emoji Guess Puzzle: AI asks you to express a phrase, saying, or film title using emojis. Read the clue and select the correct symbols in the required order. Use hints when a combination is unclear and continue interpreting the next illustrated or written prompt.

pages.title: Noob Fall
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Noob Fall has you control a descent using a large stick to stop along the way. Pause at useful moments to avoid the traps and continue toward the finish. Manage those stops without waiting too long, since the clock keeps counting down.

pages.title: I Like Pizza
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: I Like Pizza challenges you to collect and stack dough while preparing food for customers. Expand from pizza into other products such as donuts and hotdogs. Improve the foods to increase earnings and deliver as much of the finished output as possible.

pages.title: Bumpy Ball
pages.creator: Mak Game Hub
pages.description: Bumpy Ball asks you to smash objects matching the ball's color while avoiding every other color. Time the tap-controlled movement to pass the right barriers. Keep reading the colors ahead as you work to carry the ball farther through the course.

pages.title: Balls Numbers Match !
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Balls Numbers Match ! combines ball shooting with number merging. Fire a ball beside another showing the same value so their numbers add together. Keep building larger values through matching neighbors and work toward creating a ball worth 2048.

pages.title: Roller Ski Queen
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Roller Ski Queen sends a skater through an ice-course challenge. Collect sharp blades that help destroy obstacles and gather coins along the route. Spend the money on additional skating outfits as you continue guiding the character through the obstacles ahead.

pages.title: 3D Tangram
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: 3D Tangram gives you seven pieces to arrange into a reference pattern. Drag the shapes into position and tap them to rotate to the required angle. Complete twenty-five different designs by fitting every piece into the target outline.

pages.title: Fortress Defense
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Fortress Defense puts your castle under attack and asks you to build a stronger defense. Add or improve archers and use effects such as lightning, freezing, or poison against the invaders. Keep the attacking forces away from the stronghold as the battle continues.

pages.title: Match Shapes
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Match Shapes asks you to place blocks on a board and merge groups of at least three similar shapes. Rotate the incoming pieces when needed to find a better fit. Keep combining them to open additional shape types as the levels progress.

pages.title: Warfare Area 2
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Warfare Area 2 puts you in a first-person rifle battle against enemies throughout an occupied area. Move between firing positions, reload when needed, and eliminate every opponent. Collect first-aid kits during the mission to help the character survive the continuing firefights.

pages.title: Stickman Death Run
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Stickman Death Run sends a stick figure through a dangerous pixel-art world. Use the movement controls to keep running past the obstacles along the route. Watch each approaching hazard and guide the character through the course without letting the death run end early.

pages.title: Santa Present Delivery
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Santa Present Delivery is a jigsaw collection featuring twelve Christmas-themed pictures. Choose twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces for the selected image. Drag the sections together to restore the complete holiday scene before trying another puzzle from the set.

pages.title: Super Cars Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Super Cars Jigsaw Puzzle offers eight vehicle pictures to reconstruct. Choose a two-by-three, three-by-four, or four-by-six layout, then drag every piece into its exact place. Rebuild the selected supercar image by matching the details across its scattered sections.

pages.title: Super Sushi Cat a pult
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Super Sushi Cat a pult challenges you to launch a cat for distance. Click or touch to set the throw's power, then send the cat flying. Adjust the strength of later launches as you try to carry it farther than before.

pages.title: Miami Traffic Racer
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Miami Traffic Racer puts a yellow sports car on Miami's highways for a checkpoint-driving challenge. Steer through traffic and collect coins, cash, fuel, and speed boosts along the way. Keep the car progressing between checkpoints while gathering useful supplies on the road.

pages.title: BTS Doggy Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Doggy Coloring Book lets you decorate dog-themed drawings with your chosen colors. Select a picture and apply shades to its different areas. Complete a playful canine illustration with the palette you prefer, then continue exploring the available coloring pages.

pages.title: Cooking Fever
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Cooking Fever combines restaurant service with preparing meals and desserts from different cuisines. Use kitchen appliances to produce dishes, then improve equipment to expand the menu. Decorate the restaurants and keep serving customers as you develop the different cooking locations.

pages.title: Repair It
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Repair It puts broken electronics on your workbench for restoration. Open each device, replace damaged components, remove dust, apply thermal paste, and reassemble the parts. Complete repairs to increase your experience and unlock additional devices with new problems to fix.

pages.title: Elevator Breaking
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Elevator Breaking asks you to bring a lift safely down to the ground. Use the left mouse button to control its descent when hazards block the way. Reach the lower destination without a collision to finish the level and continue to another elevator challenge.

pages.title: Fire Balls
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fire Balls challenges you to shoot a stacked tower while obstacles move around it. Choose clear moments to fire and keep the balls away from the blocking objects. A collision ends the attempt, so time the shots carefully while building your score.

pages.title: Birthday Cake Puzzle
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Birthday Cake Puzzle turns pictures of decorated cakes into jigsaws. Move the scattered pieces into position to rebuild each cake image, using the colored icing and cake shapes to work out how the sections fit together.

pages.title: Grand Robot Car Transform 3D Game
pages.creator: gamefun
pages.description: Grand Robot Car Transform 3D Game combines vehicle driving with robot battles in a large city. Control the transforming character through the different modes and use fighting or shooting attacks against its opponents. Follow the on-screen objectives as you move between car and robot action.

pages.title: Army Weapon Vehicles Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Army Weapon Vehicles Match 3 asks you to line up at least three matching military-vehicle pieces. Clear groups to earn points while keeping the side meter from falling too far. Continue choosing useful combinations before the declining gauge ends the round.

pages.title: Water Cleaner
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Water Cleaner gives you two moving guns for cleaning polluted drops with special shots. Watch the weapons' positions and fire at the contaminated targets when they line up. Use both sides to keep hitting the dirty droplets as the shooting challenge continues.

pages.title: Pull The Pin
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Pull The Pin challenges you to release a ball into a cup by withdrawing pins. Choose which barrier to remove and consider how the ball will move afterward. Complete the puzzle by creating a route that delivers it into the waiting container.

pages.title: Princess Holiday Choice
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Holiday Choice helps Clara, Bella, and Mia prepare for a trip together. Browse the available clothing and choose an outfit for each princess. Finish their looks, then decide which holiday destination the group should visit for the vacation.

pages.title: CraftMine
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: CraftMine combines resource gathering with a day-to-day survival challenge. Mine materials and craft them into items that unlock more possibilities. Avoid wild creatures, find food and water, and keep the character warm while trying to survive a longer stretch of days.

pages.title: Save Santa Claus
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Save Santa Claus asks you to bring Santa safely back to the ground while avoiding bombs. Remove wooden supports in a useful order and consider what will fall when each one disappears. Work through twenty different rescue layouts.

pages.title: Finger Soccer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Finger Soccer puts football teams on a tabletop-style pitch with movable player pieces. Drag a player to send the ball toward the opposing goal, arranging passes and shots while protecting your own end of the field.

pages.title: Box Blast
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Box Blast is a physics puzzle about pushing a box with explosions. Tap to apply a blast and judge the direction its force will send the block. Use carefully placed impacts to move the box around the arrangement and into the finish point.

pages.title: Hole 24
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Hole 24 gives you twenty-four golf puzzles that unlock in sequence. Drag from the ball to choose the shot's direction and strength, then release to send it toward the hole. Complete the current course to open the next putting challenge.

pages.title: Dinosaur Hunting Dino Attack 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Dinosaur Hunting Dino Attack 3D sends you into a dinosaur-hunting simulation with ranged weapons. Move through the terrain, aim carefully, and shoot the prehistoric targets. Switch weapons or crouch when needed as you handle the different positions required by the hunting action.

pages.title: FootyZag
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: FootyZag offers a football challenge with twenty unusual teams. Choose the left or right input to direct a pass or kick and keep the team's attack moving. Time your decisions through the match as you work toward outplaying the other side.

pages.title: 2020 Honda Civic Si Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: 2020 Honda Civic Si Puzzle features six photographs of the car as jigsaws. Choose sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces for the selected image. Drag the sections into place until the vehicle's details join into the complete picture.

pages.title: Moto Cruiser Highway
pages.creator: More Awesome Games
pages.description: Moto Cruiser Highway lets you ride with a motorcycle gang along American highway routes. Choose a male or female rider and select a bike from different designs and colors. Steer through six tracks, braking for difficult sections and changing the camera when useful.

pages.title: American Cars Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: American Cars Memory hides vehicle pictures behind a set of cards. Reveal two at a time and remember earlier images to find their partners. Complete four increasingly demanding levels by clearing every matching pair before the available time runs out.

pages.title: Antique Vehicles Puzzle 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Antique Vehicles Puzzle 2 gives you six classic-vehicle pictures to rebuild. Select a layout from sixteen to one hundred pieces and work through the scattered sections. Fit the details together to restore the chosen antique vehicle at the difficulty you prefer.

pages.title: Box Runner
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Box Runner follows a runner through a scrolling obstacle course. Time jumps and double jumps to clear the boxes in the way, collecting coins and building distance as the pace of the run increases.

pages.title: EG Stick Monkey
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Stick Monkey challenges you to build crossings between platforms by growing a stick. Hold the input until its length seems right, then use it as a bridge. A stick that is too short or too long will not provide a safe route across.

pages.title: Food Rush Traffic
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Food Rush Traffic sends your car through a stream of road traffic. Switch lanes and jump to avoid crashing into other vehicles, keeping the drive going to build your score. Different car appearances are available to select.

pages.title: Offroad Monster Trucks
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Offroad Monster Trucks gives you several vehicles to drive across three environments. Steer through the terrain, use the handbrake, and switch camera views to judge your route. Change vehicles when you want to try another machine in the off-road driving areas.

pages.title: Color Path
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Color Path challenges you to keep a character hopping along colored platforms. Choose between the red and yellow buttons to match the path ahead, timing your choices as the platforms fall away and collecting coins along the route.

pages.title: Super Fighting Robots Defense
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Super Fighting Robots Defense asks you to protect the unfinished BOMBER 2000 spacecraft from invaders. Place defensive towers on the board and use them to hold back attacks. Keep the base secure while the powerful ship remains the last hope against the galactic threat.

pages.title: EG Circle Clock
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Circle Clock challenges you to place a moving pointer in the correct part of a colored circle. Time each click or tap to register the required alignment and earn points. The action gradually accelerates, leaving less time to judge the next position.

pages.title: Goblin Run
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description: Goblin Run sends a green goblin across platforms in an endless running challenge. Jump over the gaps and stay out of the mud below. Collect bonus gold and eat meat to gain extra jumps while airborne, helping the character continue farther through the route.

pages.title: Dragon Killer
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Dragon Killer Archery puts you on defense against incoming dragons. Hold to aim and release an arrow, targeting weak points for a better score. Charge the powerful ultimate attack and choose heroes with different abilities as you protect the kingdom from the airborne threat.

pages.title: EG Mad Racing
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Mad Racing challenges you to control a car over steep climbs and descents. Balance its movement through the terrain, perform tricks for bonuses, and collect coins along the route. Spend the earnings on upgrades that help the vehicle reach greater distances.

pages.title: Cotton Candy Shop
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Cotton Candy Shop lets you make and decorate a custom cotton candy treat. Choose its shape, stick and flavor, operate the machine and gather the spun sugar. Add decorative details and wrapping before trying the finished creation.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Thanksgiving Jigsaw combines seasonal picture puzzles with unlocking more images. Complete the first scene to earn in-game money, then spend puzzle winnings on additional pictures. Choose among three difficulties, with harder arrangements offering more earnings toward the next Thanksgiving image.

pages.title: Princess Lost Toys
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Lost Toys helps Emma search for belongings she misplaced around the city. Visit places such as the mall and park, then examine each scene for the missing toys. Recover the items from the locations where she remembers playing with them.

pages.title: Wire Hoop
pages.creator: Creacle
pages.description: Wire Hoop challenges you to keep a hoop moving without touching the wire running through it. Tap to make the hoop jump and judge the next gap carefully. Staying clear of the wire lets you continue building a higher score.

pages.title: Ice Castle Cleaning
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ice Castle Cleaning gives you rooms left messy after a large party. Put scattered clothing into the basket, vacuum the floor, and throw rubbish away. Continue into the bathroom and bedroom to finish tidying the different areas of the ice castle.

pages.title: Sailor Scouts Avatar Maker
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Sailor Scouts Avatar Maker lets you build an existing Sailor-style character or design a new one. Combine the available appearance and outfit choices to complete an avatar. Use Shuffle to generate a random combination when you want another starting point for the design.

pages.title: Night Watchmen Stories Zombie Hospital
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Night Watchmen Stories Zombie Hospital turns a hospital night shift into a horror shooting adventure. Explore the building with weapons including a pistol, shotgun, minigun, and explosives. Pick up useful items and fight the threats encountered after the watchman's troubled sleep.

pages.title: Ice Cream Pirates
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Ice Cream Pirates asks you to defend a treasure supply from approaching pirates. Drag traps into positions where they can stop the attackers before they reach the loot. Plan the defensive arrangement and protect the treasure as the pirate assault continues.

pages.title: Pop Stone 2
pages.creator: Freelance
pages.description: Pop Stone 2 challenges you to remove clusters of at least two adjacent pieces sharing a color. Tap a group to clear it from the grid, with larger groups earning more points. Consider how each removal affects the remaining arrangement before choosing another cluster.

pages.title: Couples Midnight Fun
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Couples Midnight Fun helps Ellie and Annie choose outfits for time with their boyfriends. Browse the dresses and put together a look for each girl. Offer fashion choices that suit the outing as you finish the friends' preparations for their evening together.

pages.title: Youtubers Pinata Psycho Fan
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Youtubers Pinata Psycho Fan turns caricatures of online creators into virtual piñata targets. Strike them to earn money and build the character's in-game internet career. Spend the proceeds on unusual weapons that change how you attack the next piñata-style challenge.

pages.title: Summer in the City
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Summer in the City lets you put together an outfit for a city outing. Choose a hairstyle, clothing, shoes and accessories, mixing the available pieces into a complete look. Show the finished style once the combination is ready.

pages.title: Bubble Hamsters
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Bubble Hamsters pairs its hamster characters with a color-matching bubble shooter. Aim the crossbow to connect three or more bubbles of the same color, popping the group and dropping clusters that lose their support above.

pages.title: Cowboy Zombie
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Cowboy Zombie combines farm-animal riding with quick arithmetic answers. Read each math question and select the correct response to help the zombie keep riding. Continue solving the problems promptly as you try to extend the character's time on the animals.

pages.title: Pregnant Princesses Fashion Outfits
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pregnant Princesses Fashion Outfits gives two expectant princesses a wardrobe update. Look through the available clothes and select new combinations for each character. Complete both styling sessions by choosing the fashion outfits you want the princesses to wear together.
